purpose: Lightweight skill index. Load full SKILL.md only when selected.

skills.description: Check semantics, keyboard, focus, ARIA, labels, screen reader behavior, contrast assumptions, and error messaging.
Define AI behavior contract, context/data access, tool permissions, latency/cost, fallback, and human escalation.
Review AI risks: prompt injection, hallucination impact, unsafe tools, sensitive data, guardrails, and approvals.
Define event taxonomy, metrics, properties, data source, segmentation, dashboards, and caveats.
Identify likely future expectations, hidden quality risks, and proactive improvement proposals requiring explicit approval before scope changes.
Review API contract schemas, compatibility, versioning, errors, idempotency, pagination, and contract tests.
Plan architecture boundaries, NFRs, interfaces, risks, trade-offs, and implementation sequence.
Scan component imports, props, variants, duplicate custom UI, token usage, and forbidden one-off implementations.
Review UX copy, terminology, empty/error/success states, CTA clarity, accessibility, localization readiness.
Design conversational flows, intents, turns, confirmations, repair, fallback, tone, and human handoff.
Controlled ideation using focal objects, synectics, SCAMPER, TRIZ-lite, pre-mortem, and OST without confusing hypotheses with evidence.
Use controlled creative perspectives to challenge a decision and produce bounded improvement options.
Use when reviewing a rendered page or interface prototype for product clarity, DS fidelity, taste, obvious UI issues, and implementation fidelity.
Classify support signals by frequency, severity, evidence strength, user segment, and product implication.
Map customer journey, channels, touchpoints, backstage dependencies, emotions, support/service gaps.
Review data model, storage, lineage, quality, retention, and data lifecycle implications.
Review chart/dashboard/report design, metric semantics, misleading visuals, scales, aggregation, cognitive load.
Assess dependency necessity, alternatives, maintenance, license, security, bundle/perf, rollback.
Structured critique of design alternatives using goals, constraints, trade-offs, and evidence-labeled recommendations.
Validate design-only handoff packages so developers can rebuild without guessing.
Final design QA gate for UI tasks: screen spec coverage, DS fidelity, states, copy, accessibility, responsive behavior.
Discover design-system level, component registry, tokens, style conventions, UI patterns, Figma/design docs, and implementation constraints.
Check UI changes against DS manifest, components, tokens, variants, anti-patterns, and approved deviations.
Create or update a compact DESIGN_SYSTEM_MANIFEST.json from code/docs/DS folder evidence.
Plan CI/CD, env/config, feature flags, deployment, rollout, rollback, and release gates.
Enforce DS code contracts using manifest, import scans, raw UI scans, and approved deviation records.
Define and optionally run screenshot/state capture for key UI states and breakpoints.
Capture good and bad examples as reusable taste evidence and convert them into design rules and anti-patterns.
Generate forward-looking proposals that may improve quality or meet hidden expectations, requiring approval before scope changes.
Design experiments, pilots, A/B tests, hypotheses, metrics, guardrails, and decision rules.
When external facts are needed but unavailable, produce research plan/source list instead of unsupported claims.
Plan onboarding, activation, retention, conversion, growth loop, ethical experiments, and metrics.
Create PR description, release notes, docs, reviewer checklist, handoff summary based on evidence.
Review implementation against TASK, approved plan, tests, gates, risks, and output PASS/WARN/BLOCKED.
Investigate incidents with timeline, impact, root cause, contributing factors, remediation, prevention.
Design taxonomy, navigation, hierarchy, grouping, labeling, findability, and IA validation approach.
Check strings, variables, pluralization, formats, text expansion, locale assumptions, and hardcoded copy.
Plan market research: category, alternatives, competitors, positioning, pricing/adoption hypotheses, evidence sources.
Plan schema/data/config migrations, compatibility, backfill, validation, rollback, and observability.
Create AI eval matrix, cases, failure taxonomy, rubrics, thresholds, and regression criteria.
Design a full product module with IA, flows, screen inventory, component matrix, state matrix, content, accessibility, and developer handoff.
Define logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, alerts, runbook hints, and debug signals.
Classify new ideas/signals as OE-0..OE-4 and decide ignore/log/improve/re-plan/block.
Assess performance risks and measurement plan for UI/API/data/infra changes.
Map data categories, purpose, access, sharing, retention, consent, deletion, and privacy risks.
Review proactive suggestions for evidence level, scope impact, user value, cost, and approval need before they enter the plan.
Plan product scope, MVP slice, non-goals, user value, acceptance criteria, and success metrics.
Run production readiness gates across product, architecture, UI/DS, security, privacy, performance, release, and verification.
Plan production web/service work using phased orchestration and readiness gates.
Update CHRONICLE compactly with decisions, current state, next action, risks, files, subagent activity.
Create a lightweight local UI contract for fast prototypes when no design system exists.
Plan behavior-preserving refactor stages, tests, risks, and rollback.
Inspect an existing repository shallowly: stack, package manager, scripts, instructions, generated zones, patterns, tests.
Plan recruiting, screener, consent, scheduling, incentives, storage, privacy, and research repository hygiene.
Plan evidence-gathering work, method choice, participants, protocol, synthesis, confidence, and caveats.
Review cross-cutting risk gates and produce PASS/WARN/BLOCKED risk verdict.
Produce a Screen Design Spec for new/redesigned screens with purpose, hierarchy, actions, states, component tree, responsive behavior.
Alias-level skill for security-sensitive review; prefer threat-modeling for detailed work.
Audit the framework execution, instruction conflicts, routing, gates, role/skill usage, and failure modes.
Design service blueprint across frontstage/backstage actions, systems, policies, handoffs, and failure points.
Define UI state matrix: empty, loading, success, error, disabled, permission, partial, optimistic, responsive edge cases.
Use when one or more real subagents are still running, failed, duplicated, or did not return a usable artifact.
Plan and execute true subagent workflow with explicit user approval, bounded tasks, exact agent names, outputs, and stop conditions.
Use before spawning real subagents to create a bounded task, evidence requirements, read/write permissions, output schema, and stop condition.
Turn a request into a scoped task brief using Micro/Fast/Standard/Risk-first intake. Ask only decision-changing questions.
Define task-specific taste profile, examples, anti-examples, quality bar, and review checklist for design-facing work.
Review design or implemented UI against taste profile, team culture, DS constraints, and user goal with PASS/WARN/BLOCKED verdict.
Select the smallest sufficient roles, skills, services, and orchestration mode. Produce selected-role contract.
Build evidence-backed security threat model, findings, mitigations, and tests.
Run obvious UI errors checklist: hierarchy, actions, states, copy, accessibility, responsiveness, consistency.
Use before UI review subagents or multi-lens review to package URL, screenshot, changed files, DS mode, component sources, console/build status, and review focus.
Create UX research questions, method, screener, protocol, usability tasks, synthesis plan, and confidence levels.
Render or inspect UI states, capture screenshots if possible, compare against spec and DS constraints, report visual blockers.
